segments.text: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: I saw a basket of summer fruit.

footnotes.text: + Or ripe fruit; also in verse 2

segments.text: Amos, what do you see?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: He asked.
A basket of summer fruit,
segments.speaker: Amos

segments.text: I replied. So the LORD said to me,
The end has come for My people Israel; I will no longer spare them.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: In that day,
segments.speaker: The Lord GOD

segments.text: declares the Lord GOD,
the songs of the temple will turn to wailing. Many will be the corpses, strewn in silence everywhere!
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Hear this, you who trample the needy, who do away with the poor of the land,
asking,
When will the New Moon be over, that we may sell grain? When will the Sabbath end, that we may market wheat? Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel; let us cheat with dishonest scales.
segments.speaker: The people

footnotes.text: + Or Let us reduce the measure and increase the price

segments.text: Let us buy the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the chaff with the wheat!
segments.speaker: Oppressors

segments.text: The LORD has sworn by the Pride of Jacob:
I will never forget any of their deeds.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
Will not the land quake for this, and all its dwellers mourn? All of it will swell like the Nile; it will surge and then subside
like the Nile in Egypt.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: And in that day, declares the Lord GOD, I will make the sun go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the daytime.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation. I will cause everyone to wear sackcloth and every head to be shaved. I will make it like a time of mourning for an only son, and its outcome like a bitter day.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord GOD, when I will send a famine on the land— not a famine of bread or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: People will stagger from sea to sea and roam from north to east, seeking the word of the LORD, but they will not find it.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: In that day the lovely young women— the young men as well— will faint from thirst.
segments.speaker: Amos

segments.text: Those who swear by the guilt of Samaria and say, ‘As surely as your god lives, O Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the way of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again.
segments.speaker: Amos
